Resolves #20541

Demo B's perspective workflow now lives in `DemoBPerspectiveHost`: capture, restore preflight, Group commit, activation/reporting and the store-driven switcher. The host retains public facades, state and lifetime. Cached panes now retain their document-derived tab titles, so Workbench, Inspector, Timeline and Console stay visible through perspective changes and popup return. This candidate also fixes the grid-menu teardown defect that failed its CI, tracked by #20564: disabling menus now retires their trigger references before an ancestor VNode traversal.

Change class: restoration overall. The seven perspective method bodies remain zero-delta. Title metadata is restored at pane creation; the menu repair consumes the existing component destruction contract. Neither repair adds an API.

The branch includes merged native-host effects from `dev f4781c2a97`. All seven perspective bodies match the previously reviewed extraction; the host and six mixins have 111 unique instance methods, with no collisions or retained implementation copies. Merged native effects are unchanged.

| Perspective scope | Before raw / code lines | After raw / code lines |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| DemoBWorkspace | 2,126 / 1,098 | 1,890 / 943 |
| New perspective host | 0 / 0 | 280 / 174 |
| Combined | 2,126 / 1,098 | 2,170 / 1,117 |

Including the two restored header entries, the host loses 236 raw lines; composition and documentation add 44 raw / 19 code lines across these two files. Its size exception is removed because it is below the guard's 1,000-code-line target. Parent #15614's distinct raw-line target remains open.

Evidence: L3 (headed perspective/tour journeys plus BigData browser validation and a red-first lifecycle regression) → L3 required. No leaf residuals.

## Deltas from ticket

The CI prerequisite is included in this merge candidate. `Menu.destroy` replaces manual VDOM filtering with `trigger.destroy(updateOwner, true)`, sharing the existing owner-liveness guard with its batched update. Parent cleanup runs while the header is live; owner teardown retains its prior path because the inline filter may already have retired.

The extraction itself preserves behavior; `resolvePane` now supplies `header.text` from the document title or item-ID fallback on both creation paths. A distinct internal restore name preserves the host facade. Earlier documentation clarifications remain: the switcher gains stored-perspective buttons, and invalid non-committing preflight can render its error report.
